scene: The scrolls reveal routes: three transit links wait right outside the balcony.
picture: Flat side-view pixel art of a rooftop transit deck past the tea shed balcony. On the far left, a red Bento Express train sits beside a boarding gate. Left of centre, the grandfather pushes his plant-laden bicycle. In the centre, an orange koi-shaped boat idles in water. On the far right, a yellow streetcar waits on tracks.
shown: a sleek red Bento Express train parked at the open platform on the far left
a mechanical orange koi boat floating beside the wooden pier in the centre
a yellow retro streetcar waiting at a track siding on the far right
